INDEPENDENT DEMO PROJECT · 2026

BOLTERRA

A responsive tool and consumable catalog with 25 demo products and a working browser prototype.

The task

Design a catalog without checkout: help visitors choose a tool type, compare specifications and explore related consumables.

What I built

  • Categories, name and SKU search, power supply and voltage filters, and sorting.
  • Product details, type-specific specifications, tabs and links between tools and consumables.
  • Responsive layouts, keyboard navigation and an informative demo dialog instead of checkout.

Project status and assets

This is an independent demonstration project, not client work or a real manufacturer website. Models and specifications are fictional, and visuals were created using modern AI tools. Related-item suggestions do not certify technical compatibility. No sales or enquiry collection are available.

My role: structure, UI design, responsive implementation and verification. The working brand name has not been checked for trademark registration.
